[1/4] BPE heap plan: baseline encode timing, heap encoder, differential + A/B, revert + report

impact_assessment.why: Tokenizer BPE encode rescans every adjacent pair per merge, O(n^2) with a fresh string per test; long prompts pay it before prefill.
impact_assessment.benefits: Expected >=2x encode on long prompts plus identical ids; prompt latency only, no numerics.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: ids byte-identical including leftmost tie order; dependency: none; concurrency: tokenizer encode is const, no shared mutation; state: tokenizer-only temporary spike, fully reverted.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Differential ids on synthetic fixtures and real prompts, build+tests each change, best-of-3 A/B, full revert.

[1/4] No-init KV plan: measure load-vs-context, replace eager zero-fill with uninitialized cache allocation, verify ids/fidelity/f16/i8, revert + report

impact_assessment.why: Qwen2::load zero-fills the whole KV cache (assign(cache_elements,0)): ~896 MiB at Llama-3B ctx 4096, ~185 ms of the 200 ms load, while only the used positions are ever read.
impact_assessment.benefits: Expected 4x+ startup load at ctx 4096 and lower total memory traffic; short prompts touch only the used KV pages.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: every KV read must be preceded by a write for that position; dependency: allocator type change in qwen2.hpp; concurrency: caches are per-model, not shared; state: f32/f16/i8 and prefix/batch paths must stay exact.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Custom no-init allocator only for cache members, resize not assign, full suite + fidelity + id parity across f32/f16/i8 and continuous batching, then revert.

[1/4] Tokenizer sidecar plan: split parse/build, add keyed binary source cache, id parity + warm A/B, revert + report

impact_assessment.why: from_path reparses the GGUF metadata (tokens/merges/types/scores) on every text invocation; the parsed arrays are stable for a given model file and cost ~38 ms before the ~65 ms map build.
impact_assessment.benefits: Warm tokenizer construction should drop toward the map-build floor, cutting 30-40 ms of parse from each repeated CLI/API start with identical ids.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: cached arrays must be byte-equivalent to GGUF values; dependency: no new deps; concurrency: cache writes must be atomic enough to ignore partial files; state: temp-only cache keyed by model size+mtime.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Versioned magic/key, size caps, rebuild-on-any-error, id parity on fixtures and thinking set, full revert.

[1/4] Flat tokenizer index plan: replace unordered_map vocab/merge tables with arena-backed open addressing, id parity + build-time A/B, revert + report

impact_assessment.why: Cycle 3 showed the tokenizer source cache caps at 1.24x because unordered_map construction of ~400k keys is ~65-80 ms and dominates every load.
impact_assessment.benefits: A single-allocation arena plus open addressing should cut map build time and lookup pointer-chasing; reusable for both vocab_ and merge_rank_ with identical first-insert/erase semantics.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: duplicate keys keep the first value, erase uses tombstones, find returns stable int pointer; dependency: none; concurrency: tokenizer is const during encode, tables are frozen after build; state: tokenizer-only temporary spike.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Differential ids on synthetic fixtures + thinking set, 145-test suite, interleaved A/B, full revert.
